turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes, and I'd like to start with why my son found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class. Who decided to enter that mark, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
You're welcome. Now answer me: who entered the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
Here is my offer. I will change the zero to 70 percent today if you drop the complaint and we never mention it again.
A mark in exchange for "never mention it again." I'm writing that down, Hale, and the principal will see it before I leave this building. Either the essay earned a zero or it didn't, so which is it?
Nobody has to know. Do we have a deal?
No. "Nobody has to know" is going on the pad right under the last offer, Hale. Tell me what you actually have on the essay, or I go upstairs now.
